map.note: 12 territories in 3 continents (northlands: 4, midlands: 4, southlands: 4). Adjacency edges define which territories can attack each other.

army.note: Army tokens placed on territories. Count per territory tracked as game state.

phases.name: reinforce
phases.note: Player receives max(3, territories_owned / 3) + continent_bonus armies and places them on owned territories.

phases.name: attack
phases.ends_when: player passes or has no valid attacks
phases.note: Attacker rolls up to 3d6 (must have >1 army in source, max dice = armies-1 capped at 3). Defender rolls up to 2d6 (max dice = armies in territory capped at 2). Compare dice highest-to-highest: loser of each pair removes 1 army. Defender wins ties. If defender reaches 0, attacker must move attacking dice count of armies into conquered territory.

phases.name: fortify
phases.note: Player may move armies from one owned territory to an adjacent owned territory. Must leave at least 1 army behind. One fortify move per turn.

minimum_garrison.definition: Every territory must always have at least 1 army

attack_adjacency.constraint: source and target must be adjacent on the map graph

constraints: source must be owned by the attacker
target must be owned by a different player

attack_dice.definition: Attacker rolls min(armies_in_source - 1, 3) d6. Defender rolls min(armies_in_target, 2) d6.
attack_dice.server_resolves: sort both rolls descending, compare pairs highest-to-highest, defender wins ties

conquest.trigger: defender territory reaches 0 armies after combat
conquest.effect: attacker moves at least attack_dice_count armies from source to conquered territory; territory ownership changes to attacker

fortify_adjacency.constraint: source and target must be adjacent and both owned by the current player

reinforcement_count.definition: Armies received = max(3, territories_owned / 3) + continent_bonus for each fully controlled continent
